note: PR0 inventory generated from the real artboard data-props footers. Every evidence path is null and every state row starts pending; do not treat this file as proof of a captured app state.

runtimeProtocol.verificationNote: Static source inspection only. The API tokens exist in support.js; the parent capture harness must confirm boot/rootName/setProps at runtime before using this protocol as evidence.
runtimeProtocol.note: Verified against the published support.js in this repo. Use this protocol only; do not invent props, add query params, or edit HTML/DOM to force a tweak.

propsApi.rootNameSource: Set by the runtime from location.pathname via Pt()/It(); not necessarily the full file path.
propsApi.setPropsSemantics: sets registry[rootName].propOverrides = {...propsObject} (replaces the previous override object), then re-renders. The component receives {...data-props defaults, ...overrides}; unknown props are not validated and must not be used.
propsApi.propsArgument: Object of only keys from the board data-props footer excluding $preview; enum values must be one of options, boolean true|false. No invented props.
propsApi.validateBeforeSet: Assert each key exists in registry[rootName].propsMeta, each enum value is in that prop options, and each boolean is true|false; never pass $preview or an unknown key.
propsApi.readMeta: iframe.contentWindow.__dcRegistry[rootName].propsMeta or the __dc_booted message .propsMeta (same footer metadata, $preview separate).
propsApi.defaults: Use data-props[property].default; the runtime merges defaults under overrides.
propsApi.boot: Runtime auto-boots on DOMContentLoaded. __dcBoot() re-parses the current document and is not a tweak API.
propsApi.lowLevelUpdate: iframe.contentWindow.__dcUpdate(rootName, 'props', JSON.stringify(propsObject), false, ...) exists, but prefer __dcSetProps for tweaks.
propsApi.noDomMutation: Do not edit data-props, DOM, or HTML to apply a tweak.

iframeToParent.when: design mode changes or a __dc_probe is received

postMessage.propsAreNotPostMessage: There is no postMessage type in support.js that sets props. Use __dcSetProps on the same-origin iframe window.

usage.load: Serve apps/viderse/docs/design/v1 statically and load artboards/<Board>.dc.html in a same-origin iframe/window.
usage.wait: Wait for the __dc_booted message (rootName/mounted/propsMeta) or poll __dcRootName() until it is not the fallback Root and the registry entry exists.
usage.multipleTweaks: Pass all desired overrides in one object; __dcSetProps replaces the previous override object.
usage.fullDefaultsPatch: Row capture: contentWindow.__dcSetProps(rootName, { ...row.defaults, ...row.context, ...row.patch }); reset with contentWindow.__dcSetProps(rootName, {}).
usage.afterSet: Wait for the React commit/next paint and images/fonts; assert propOverrides equals the requested object before capture.
usage.fonts: await contentWindow.document.fonts.ready before the screenshot; wait for images/finite animations per verification.md.

query.theme: ?theme=dark is parsed from location.search; no tweak value is parsed from the URL by support.js.

rowSemantics.expectedVisible: Target acceptance for the owning PR; not an observed app state.
rowSemantics.baseline: Current repository/artboard baseline at PR0. knownGap is an existing mismatch, not a target pass/fail.
rowSemantics.status: pending = PR0 has not captured reference/app/comparison/control-ledger/motion evidence yet; it is neither pass nor fail.
rowSemantics.exclusion: An exclusion object names a top-level out-of-scope item; it does not mark the row as passed or excluded.
rowSemantics.props: Full data-props metadata for the row artboard (excluding $preview), for validating __dcSetProps input.
rowSemantics.defaults: Default values for every data-prop on this artboard. Capture should call __dcSetProps(rootName, {...row.defaults, ...row.context, ...row.patch}).
rowSemantics.context: Parent-view/context values required for the tweak to be visible (tab, section, screen, step, dialog, panel). Merged between defaults and patch, so the row property in patch always wins. Empty object when the footer default already exposes the tweak.
rowSemantics.patch: Exactly {property: value} for this row; merging it over defaults+context sets only this state while retaining the other defaults.

statuses.pending: Not captured yet; expected in PR0 for every row/probe.
statuses.excluded: Explicitly outside V36–V40; must not be implemented or counted as pass.
statuses.blocked: A real prerequisite is missing; record the exact blocker instead of faking a result.

evidencePolicy.screenshotRule: Each row needs reference/app/comparison images at 1440×900 and 390×844 (or a sourced not-applicable for the side without a design) under reports/pr-NN/{reference,app,comparison}/ with viewport, DPR, font status, revision, seed, and state in JSON.
evidencePolicy.controlOracleRule: Every visible button/link/[role=tab|radio|switch], including opened menus/sheets, needs an accessible role/name, enabled/disabled reason, expected and observed effect, and API/readback. A click count or toast alone is not a pass.
evidencePolicy.motionRule: Capture opening→visible→closing→unmounted, rapid toggle, route change, focus return, scroll restore, normal and reduced motion; do not disable animation in the motion pass.
evidencePolicy.seedRule: Use authored QA fixtures only as labelled inputs to real constructors/API/DB. They are not proof of real AI drawing/fallback. Never mock app state or DOM for screenshots.
evidencePolicy.isolationRule: Before any mutation: separate HOME/.viderse/auth.json, app DB, identity DB, media/blob store, browser storage, and approved QA provider credentials. Missing any boundary blocks logout/draw/write smoke.

probes.prerequisite: QA channel in Nguồn & tự động with a real perDay value and no production channel mutation.
probes.expectedVisible: 0/21 are rejected with a user-visible range reason; 1/20 save and read back; the stepper disables at bounds. Existing >20 data must stop for a preflight question, never be clamped.

baseline.mapping: screens/channel/SourcesTab.tsx / PaceStepper.tsx; old autonomy/rotation path at baseline.
baseline.knownGap: V38 introduces perDay 1–20; the 01 W2 1–50 text is recorded as a source conflict.

probes.dcPropNote: No perDay data-prop exists; Channel.tab=sources and Channel.autoApprove frame the automation block. Probe value derived from 08 V38/01 §W11, not invented as a DC prop.

probes.prerequisite: Real scored images on a QA video; one channel with autoApprove off and one on.
probes.expectedVisible: 84 keeps the whole video in Chờ duyệt; 85 with every image ≥85 auto-approves only when the switch is on; 100 passes. Toggling off never auto-approves.

baseline.mapping: screens/channel/SourcesTab.tsx + components/autonomy/*; old autonomy modes at baseline.
baseline.knownGap: V38 replaces autonomy with one bool at fixed 85.

probes.dcPropNote: Direct DC prop: Channel.autoApprove boolean; the 84/85/100 scores are derived boundary probes for the fixed threshold.

probes.prerequisite: Six real image cases on one QA job; score/missing/drawing/failed states come from the pipeline, not CSS.
probes.expectedVisible: Only an all-scored ≥85 batch auto-approves when the switch is on; missing/drawing/failed/below-85 images keep the video waiting.

baseline.mapping: components/autonomy/scoreSummary and job image states exist; V38 must preserve all cases.
baseline.knownGap: No fake “ready” for missing/drawing images.

probes.dcPropNote: Direct DC prop: Channel.autoApprove boolean; case names are derived image-state probes, not DC props.

probes.prerequisite: Real queue with running/manual/auto items; pause a QA queue only.
probes.expectedVisible: 0/7 are rejected or disabled with a reason; 1/6 save and apply without preempting a running job; imageConcurrency stays 3 and scan cycle 1h server-side.

baseline.mapping: screens/queue/QueueScreen.tsx, queueView.ts; old settings keys at baseline.
baseline.knownGap: V39 removes imageWorkers/rescanHours/priority from public config.

probes.dcPropNote: No workers data-prop exists; Queue.state and MQueue.sheet frame the rules UI. Probe derived from 08 V39/01 §W12.

probes.prerequisite: Real queue endpoint response on QA; no client-side override.
probes.expectedVisible: Mobile run rules show only workers + per-channel cadence; image concurrency 3 and scan cycle 1h are described as fixed, not editable controls.

baseline.mapping: screens/queue/MobileQueue.tsx; old hidden setting reads at baseline.
baseline.knownGap: V39/V40 remove the old editable keys.

probes.dcPropNote: No public fixed-value data-prop; Queue.state/MQueue.sheet frame the rules UI; values 3/1 come from 08 V39.

probes.prerequisite: Real ready videos and one non-ready/issue video; QA workbench.
probes.expectedVisible: 0 hides the sticky bar; 1/2/6 show “Tải gói N video” and only eligible ready files are included; no whole-library download.

baseline.mapping: screens/workbench/WorkbenchDesktop.tsx; selection/export logic exists but V37 must keep it real.
baseline.knownGap: Bulk download ZIP must contain exactly the selected ready videos.

probes.dcPropNote: Direct DC prop: Main.select boolean; counts 0/1/2/6 are derived selection-size probes.

domain.note: No design upper bound; probe 0/1/multi-row behavior, not an invented cap.

probes.prerequisite: Real channels/templates and one known duplicate source; isolated QA.
probes.expectedVisible: 0 disables the primary; 1 shows one row; 4 shows per-row status and “Làm N video”; duplicate rows return the existing job/queue item and are not enqueued twice.

baseline.mapping: screens/new/NewScreen.tsx; old one/many tabs and priority at baseline.
baseline.knownGap: V39 canonical POST /api/jobs + dedup; no priority flag.

probes.dcPropNote: Direct DC props: NewVideo.input and MNew.input enums; counts 0/1/4 are derived link-count probes.

probes.prerequisite: One shared standard template used by MT and QH, plus an unused template.
probes.expectedVisible: 0 shows no default chip; 1 shows “Mặc định của <kênh>”; 2 shows “Mặc định của 2 kênh” with both real channel names. Delete/rename keeps shared refs intact.

baseline.mapping: screens/library/TemplatesTab.tsx, AttachChannelDialog.tsx; rotation helpers at baseline.
baseline.knownGap: V38 single default template per channel; shared template refs allowed.

probes.dcPropNote: No defaultChannelCount DC prop; Template.fewClips and Channel.tab frame the default-template UI; 0/1/2 derive from V38 channel refs.

probes.prerequisite: Real image at a known natural size; one portrait and one landscape image.
probes.expectedVisible: Viewer never exceeds 1240×800, image uses contain and is not upscaled past natural size. The 390×844 check is the mobile MReview/MMain image presentation, not a round45 shared viewer.

baseline.mapping: Shared ImageViewer missing; Review/Editor screen-local image chrome.
baseline.knownGap: V36 creates one viewer with max 1240×800.

probes.dcPropNote: Direct DC props: Main.viewer and Review.state; frame sizes are 04-components bounds, not props.

probes.prerequisite: Every visible mobile control in each M* tweak, including sheets and opened menus.
probes.expectedVisible: All interactive targets are ≥44px; 43 is a failure probe used to catch regressions. Visual 36px controls may have a 44px hit area.

baseline.mapping: MobileShell/MMain/MChannel controls; shared kit has 44px hit-area utilities.
baseline.knownGap: V40 audits all 13 mobile boards.

probes.dcPropNote: No touch-size DC prop; MMain.screen/MChannel.sheet/MSettings.sheet frame the audited controls; 44/43 derive from verification/04-components.

probes.prerequisite: Video with a non-Vietnamese source title and a raw submitted prompt.
probes.expectedVisible: UI labels/errors/progress are Vietnamese; source video titles and the submitted/raw prompt keep their original language verbatim. Do not translate or stringify raw exceptions into the UI.

baseline.mapping: 06-copy contract applies to Review/MReview; baseline copy is mixed.
baseline.knownGap: V40 checks mobile labels/errors/feedback.

probes.dcPropNote: Direct DC props: MReview.state and Review.prompt; language cases derive from 06-copy, not props.

probes.prerequisite: QA entities with long real labels; no CSS truncation-only fake data.
probes.expectedVisible: Long labels wrap or ellipsize according to the component contract without horizontal overflow, clipping avatars, or hiding the primary action; mobile title uses the documented 16px single-line ellipsis where specified.

baseline.mapping: Shell/card/list label styles at baseline; V40 audits 360/430px and long scroll.
baseline.knownGap: No new color/type token for long labels.

probes.dcPropNote: No label-length DC prop; MMain.screen/MChannel.tab frame the audited lists; cases derive from verification long-label gate.

validation.scope: PR0 structural/source validation only; target UI acceptance is not evaluated here.

notes: Rows are an inventory only. No app/reference screenshot, comparison, click ledger, motion trace, or seed receipt is asserted.
